name: fire-spread-planks
comment: BlockFire spreading (BlockFire.java:55-199): a plank floor and wall, a plank pillar one block from the floor, a leaves hedge against the floor, wool and a log on a stone platform; fire set at t=5 on the floor (one against the leaves, one between the wool and the wall) and in the gap between floor and pillar (onBlockAdded schedules the first tick, 40). updateTick ages the fire, burns neighbours by abilityToCatchFire (tryToCatchBlockOnFire), lights air next to flammable blocks (getChanceOfNeighborsEncouragingFire) and puts out fire with nothing to burn; random ticks reach the fire too (setTickOnLoad). No rain (default weather), so canBlockBeRainedOn is always false. block_box of the structure every 10 ticks, scheduled_ticks every 10, rng_state every tick. randomDisplayTick (sounds, smoke) draws only from randomDisplayUpdates' own Random. No entity_state: the player's own update (WP-2.5) is not transcribed.
